description:
Functional specifications/files: extend test/support/openai_stub.ex only if needed for reusable synchronous Authorization capture; add grouped configured/default answering HTTP integration cases in test/zaq/agent/executor_integration_test.exs and factory coverage where appropriate.
Tests first: disabled Person/system global auth; optional Alice personal plus Bob/system global; required Alice success and Bob/system failures; provider 401 never retries with global; warm reuse remains stable. Group response, header, request count, identity isolation and structured-error assertions per fixture.
Branches: Person/non-Person, personal present/absent, global present/absent, provider rejection, configured/default answering entry points.
Mocking: reuse OpenAIStub real local HTTP edge and inspect Plug request headers; Connect, Factory, Executor and ServerManager remain real. Negative request assertions use synchronous completion/barriers, never sleeps.
Docs: test names are executable documentation; update service docs only if implementation exposes a contract mismatch.
Action reuse: not applicable — test-only coverage reuses existing Executor/Factory/OpenAIStub operations and adds no executable production operation, Action or agent tool.
